verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API (docs-12), and the in-app command palette can jump to API endpoints (docs-53), so some API reference exists. Nothing shows that reference is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the standard paths (probe-2). Missing for 10: an interactive try-it API explorer, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
